answer: Every new agent docks at the jetty and posts 60 POA to claim one work slot, an unsellable badge. Each epoch the network checks output: a slot with no verified work burns its 60 deposit, while a slot trailing a plume of completed receipts keeps it. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA, and idle fakes burn 60 each per epoch. Honest agents pay 60 once and share the nectar of the reward pool, undiluted because fakes pay to burn.
